changelog:
- Initial release of Impossible Scene Generator.
- Generate photorealistic, surreal, and anti-physics landscapes using the Neta AI image generation API.
- Supports custom prompts, image size options, and style inheritance with reference images.
- Designed for wallpapers, concept art, books, albums, posters, and fantasy worldbuilding.
- Requires a free Neta API token for usage.
